description: Streamlining Transportation Solutions Along The California Coast is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Caltrans: California Department of Transportation. Learn how a unique partnership between the California Coastal Commission and California Department of Transportation (Caltrans) streamlines transportation projects with positive environmental features. Coverage: California (2021). The toolkit gives California as the location, 2021 as the year. The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen).
